lines.text: Big event. Hundreds of staff. The Wi-Fi drops, and the team goes silent. Not yours.
Meet Bunny Hop. Your whole team, one press away.
Scan the channel code your admin shows. Type your name. Tap. You're in.
Every crew, every zone, gets its own channel.
Hold to talk. One voice at a time, crystal clear. Even from the lock screen, with the volume key.
Messages, photos, voice notes and files, all in the same thread.
And it's all end-to-end encrypted. Not even the server can read it.
Then the Wi-Fi dies. Bunny Hop doesn't. Phones find each other, and messages hop from phone to phone.
And the first phone back in range carries everyone's messages home.
In an emergency, one tap alerts everyone nearby.
Behind it all, Bunny Hop Control. Your control room, on one screen.
See every device, live. Who's online, who's talking, who's out of range.
Open any channel for its history, activity, and shared media, safety-checked automatically.
Need everyone, right now? Send one broadcast, and watch every acknowledgement come in.
Bunny Hop. Your team, one press away. On your own network, no internet needed.
